cells.gaps: The African Development Bank's 7 per cent of January 2025 names no year; the World Bank's series gives 26.5 per cent for 2024.
cells.note: The latest figure, 7 per cent of rural people in the African Development Bank's January 2025 factsheet, is below the 27 per cent line, so stage 1. Under message 138 a figure from any source counts, not only the World Bank series.
